message: Issue Category Volume and Issue Type Volume now work on a finished school year. Both sheets gain Total and % of Total columns and sort by volume by default. The Created and Closed columns detect a workbook that has stopped updating and report its last active month instead of an empty current month, naming that month in the header. Breach Rate now reads N/A instead of 0% when the workbook holds no SLA data, and Issue Type Volume always keeps the 50 largest types by volume instead of dropping them.
